name: Sawai Mari
source:
Takuma's aunt. She takes care of Takuma in place of his older sister who is busy with work. 

Although she seems to be playing with Takuma, she cares about him. 

"I'll get a man when I want one."

[From [url=https://www.ammolite-game.com/amml_036/amml_036.html#link_character]official site[/url]]
